combo1.title: Small World into Darkness: Delectation swaps in Gorging Gorge
combo1.description: Going first with Small World, Trirealm Rift Darkness and Trirealm Rift Delectation in hand. Small World reveals Darkness and bridges through Gorging Gorge (they share only their Type, Psychic) to add Blizzards, so Darkness and Gorging Gorge land face-down in your banishment, where the archetype can use them. Delectation pays its 5-card cost with Small World from the GY and the top 4 cards of the Deck. Blizzards is Normal Summoned, banishes 3 and Special Summons Darkness, which banishes 8. Delectation then banishes Blizzards face-down (its original Level is 3) and Special Summons Gorging Gorge, which banishes 6. End board, with a 40-card Deck: Trirealm Rift Darkness over 23 face-down banished cards, so it can't be destroyed by battle and has its once-per-turn Quick Effect to destroy a card on the field; Gorging Gorge, which stops your opponent's card effects from targeting or destroying Darkness and Delectation; and Delectation, whose extra Trirealm Rift Normal Summon is still unused. Ash Blossom can only answer Small World: every later add and summon comes from the banishment, not the Deck. Blizzards' effect locks you into Trirealm Rift cards for the rest of the turn, so play anything else first.

combo2.title: Small World + Hollows: three monsters from two cards
combo2.description: Going first with only Small World and Trirealm Rift Hollows. Small World reveals Hollows and bridges through Blizzards (only Psychic in common) to add Gorging Gorge, so Hollows and Blizzards are banished face-down. Gorging Gorge banishes itself from the hand as a Quick Effect and Special Summons Hollows from the banishment. Hollows banishes the top card of the Deck and adds Blizzards back to your hand. Blizzards is Normal Summoned (banish 3) and Special Summons Gorging Gorge from the banishment (banish 6). End board: Hollows, Blizzards and Gorging Gorge over 10 face-down banished cards, with Gorging Gorge stopping your opponent's card effects from targeting or destroying the other two. Hollows' add locks you into Trirealm Rift cards for the rest of the turn, so play anything else before it. Next turn, Delectation can trade Hollows or Blizzards for a Level 5 or higher monster in the banishment.

combo3.title: Going second: Blizzards and Savage Storms shuffle away a DARK monster
combo3.description: Going second into a board with a DARK monster, holding Trirealm Rift Blizzards, Savage Storms and Hollows. Your opponent controls more monsters than you, so Blizzards Special Summons itself from the hand and banishes 3. Savage Storms reveals itself and Hollows, banishes both face-down and draws 2 cards. Blizzards Special Summons Savage Storms from the banishment, and it banishes 7. Savage Storms' Quick Effect shuffles the face-down Hollows, a DARK monster, into the Deck, then shuffles your opponent's DARK monster into the Deck: no targeting and no destruction, so protection from either doesn't help it. Your Normal Summon and the 2 drawn cards are left, but Blizzards' lock means only Trirealm Rift cards can be activated for the rest of the turn. Against a monster of another Attribute, banish a Trirealm Rift monster of that Attribute with Savage Storms instead: the eight monsters cover DARK, LIGHT, WATER, FIRE, EARTH and WIND.

combo4.title: Vilvortex takes back the bridge: Darkness, Blizzards and Gorging Gorge
combo4.description: Going first with Trirealm Rift Vilvortex, Small World and Darkness. Activating Vilvortex banishes the top 5 cards of the Deck face-down. Small World reveals Darkness and bridges through Gorging Gorge to add Blizzards. Vilvortex's once-per-turn effect adds Gorging Gorge back from the banishment, and Gorging Gorge banishes itself as a Quick Effect to Special Summon Darkness, which banishes 8. Blizzards is Normal Summoned (banish 3) and Special Summons Gorging Gorge from the banishment (banish 6). End board, with a 40-card Deck: Darkness over 22 face-down banished cards (battle immunity and its Quick Effect destroy), Blizzards, and Gorging Gorge, which stops your opponent's card effects from targeting or destroying Darkness, Blizzards and Vilvortex. Only Small World can be hit by Ash Blossom. From your next turn, Vilvortex adds another face-down banished Trirealm Rift card every turn.
